#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> readArray(int size, istream& in) {
    vector<int> a(size);
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        in >> a[i];
    }
    return a;
}

vector<long long> readLongArray(int size, istream& in) {
    vector<long long> a(size);
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        in >> a[i];
    }
    return a;
}

long long fastPow(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long b = base % MOD;
    long long e = exp;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) {
            result = (result * b) % MOD;
        }
        b = (b * b) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

long long inverseTwo() {
    return fastPow(2, MOD - 2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    long long total = r - l + 1;
    if (n % 2 != 0 && m % 2 != 0) {
        cout << fastPow(total, n * m) << "\n";
    } else {
        long long res1 = fastPow(total, n * m - 1);
        long long res;
        if (total % 2 == 0) {
            res = (res1 * (total / 2)) % MOD;
        } else {
            res = ((res1 * ((total + 1) / 2)) % MOD + MOD - ((res1 + MOD - 1) % MOD * inverseTwo()) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        cout << res << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
